name: TritonGym
description: TritonGym is a benchmark and orchestration framework designed to evaluate agentic workflows in GPU code generation. It standardizes tool access via a function-call API and includes a maintained operator set, community samples, out-of-distribution tasks, and DSL extensions to ensure generality and extensibility.
reputation: A niche but practical benchmark/framework for evaluating agentic GPU code-generation workflows, with growing interest in systems and compiler communities.
notes: Focuses on agentic workflows in GPU code generation with a function-call API to separate model capability from workflow design.
